recipes.basis: HomeWorks D2R, 40-degree high-output optic, 120 V, round flanged white bevel trim. Standard ceiling mount shown; confirm thickness and installation conditions.

components.description: D2R MOUNT RD FL SHORT FLG
White round flanged bevel trim, no accessory lens

requirements: Non-IC application and manufacturer insulation clearance; not a substitution for IC new-construction housing.
Existing 4/6-inch apertures are not assumed suitable for a D2R conversion.

allowances.basis: Five Ketra S30 decorative trim-only finishes in the supplied workbook are each $82.50 cost / $150 list. Carry 20% above that same-brand decorative-trim reference for the D2R trim: $99 cost / $180 list-equivalent. This is a cross-family budget allowance, not an exact D2R supplier quote or a part substitution.
